bullet_extraction: Each - followed by whitespace after start-of-target, real newline, or literal backslash-n begins a bullet. Its span extends to the next such marker or target end, including wrapped/trailing prose. Preamble omitted, terminal special-token markers removed, marked empty bullets retained. No content filtering or deduplication.
